keyed.HH.Core.FlipBlocked: The other side is blocked: a worker could not stand there.
keyed.HH.Core.FlipBusy: Busy: {0} is using it right now.
keyed.HH.Core.FlipSideDesc: Turn this around on the spot so whoever works here stands on the other side. It keeps its place, bills and connections.
keyed.HH.Honor.PriceNote: honor system: full price, some guests pay less
keyed.HH.Honor.Report: Honor box today: {0} sales, {1} silver missing ({2} %) · all time: {3} sales, {4} underpaid, {5} unpaid, {6} silver missing
keyed.HH.Honor.ToggleDesc: Run this business unattended: guests take what they want and leave the money in the honor box, at the full price. Nobody needs to be on duty, but some guests pay less than the price and a few pay nothing at all (chances in the settings; fewer when a colonist can see them). The sign's report shows what went missing.
keyed.HH.Honor.Witnessed: {0} walked out of {1} without paying – a colonist saw it.
keyed.HH.Serve.TipsTotal: Tips for the staff so far: {0} silver
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.autoNames.Desc: A new venue sign gets a name that fits its kind of business (for example 'The Drowsy Alpaca' for a tavern). You can always rename it or roll another one.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.bellHurry.Desc: Colonists who answer the bell jog to the venue instead of walking.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.bellRange.Desc: How far the bell carries for someone with normal hearing. Walls and closed doors in between shorten it; poor hearing shortens it a lot, deaf colonists never hear it.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.bellResponders.Desc: How many colonists at most come running when the bell rings.
A colonist who was woken by the bell is not woken again for this many hours.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.bellWakes.Desc: Off: the bell only makes a sound, colonists notice it when their work lets them. Awake only: awake colonists within hearing range hurry to the venue. Wake volunteers: also colonists who sleep and have the Serving work set to priority 1 or 2 (or with simple work settings), at most once per half a day each, with a small mood cost.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.bellWho.Desc: Serving only: colonists with the Serving work type switched on. Any colonist: every colonist who is able to serve.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.browseTicks.Desc: How long a guest looks at an item before deciding. 60 ticks is one second at normal speed.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.busyServedPerHour: Busy shift: guests served per hour
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.busyServedPerHour.Desc: A shift counts as busy (good mood) when the tender served at least this many guests per hour.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.dayOpen.Desc: Hour the 'Day' preset in the sign's hours dialog opens.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.drinkGapHours.Desc: A guest does not order another drink before this many hours have passed.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.eveningClose.Desc: Hour the 'Evening' preset closes (an earlier hour than opening means after midnight).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.hideVanilla.Desc: When a Hearth & Harbor building replaces a vanilla one (for example the card table for the poker table), the vanilla one disappears from the build menu once the replacement is available. Buildings you already placed stay. Takes effect after a restart or the next game load.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.honorMessages.Desc: Show a message when a colonist saw a guest leave without paying.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.honorNoPay: Honor system: chance to pay nothing
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.honorNoPay.Desc: At an unattended honor-system venue, the chance that a guest takes the goods without paying at all.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.honorUnderpay: Honor system: chance to pay too little
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.honorUnderpay.Desc: At an unattended honor-system venue, the chance that a guest leaves only part of the price (30-80 %) in the box.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.honorWatched: Honor system: effect of being watched
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.honorWatched.Desc: How much less often guests underpay while a colonist can see them (1 = never while watched).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.idleHours.Desc: A tender who has served nobody for this many hours of a shift gets bored (bad mood, a little worse every further stretch).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.lastOrdersMinutes.Desc: In this last stretch before closing time guests in a hurry buy one more round, no guest starts a long browse and a purchase already under way is still served after closing. 0 = no last orders.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.marketCaravans.Desc: How many trader caravans come on market day (fewer if few factions are friendly).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.marketDays.Desc: Average interval of the big market, with a little randomness.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.marketEnabled.Desc: Every so often friendly factions bring several trader caravans and day visitors at once. Only happens while you run at least one shop.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.marketRenown.Desc: Minimum renown (0-100) before traders and visitors want to hold a market with you. Without a renown system the colony counts as neutral (50).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.marketStalls.Desc: The big market only happens once you own this many free-standing market stalls (traders set up at them). With fewer stalls fewer caravans come.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.marketVisitors.Desc: How many groups of day visitors come on market day, to shop in your venues.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.maxPurchases.Desc: A guest stops shopping after this many purchases in one stay.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.nightBell.Desc: Guests may ring a bell for a venue that is closed. Colonists with the Serving work type who hear it come running and open the venue for a surcharge (see the night bell settings below for who is called and who may be woken).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.nightBellMin.Desc: A bell service never costs less than this (silver).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.nightBellSurcharge.Des: Extra share of the price that guests pay when they ring the bell outside opening hours.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.nightBellWaitHours.Des: How long a guest waits after ringing before giving up ('Rang the bell. Nobody came.').
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.priceTolerance.Desc: How much guests put up with. Above 1 they accept steeper prices, below 1 they haggle with their feet. Follows the difficulty slider.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.requireSetup.Desc: A business only opens once the furniture its type needs stands in the room (a tavern needs a counter, a table and seats, a casino at least one game, and so on; see the sign's Setup tab). Off: missing furniture is only a hint.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.selfService.Desc: Venues that do not need staff but have nobody behind the counter charge this much less (the guest fetches everything themselves).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.serviceSkill.Desc: How much the Social skill of whoever is on duty matters: friendlier service, bigger purchases, tips and quicker sales. 0 = skill does not matter.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.setupHints.Desc: A selected venue sign shows build buttons for the furniture its business still needs.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.shiftThoughts.Desc: Colonists who tend a venue are pleased after a busy shift and bored when they stand around for hours with nothing to do.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.shopDesire.Desc: How eagerly guests walk into shops and taverns compared with other things they could do. 0 = they never shop.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.shopPrice.Desc: Multiplies the market value of goods sold in shops and taverns, on top of each sign's own price factor.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.staffRule.Desc: Per venue type: taverns, restaurants, casinos and spas need someone on duty, shops and lounges do not. Never: every venue runs as self-service. Always: every venue needs someone on duty.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.stallFee.Desc: Every trader caravan pays this much silver for its stall on market day (it goes into the colony till).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.tendHours.Desc: How long a colonist tends a venue before looking for other work (they also stop when it closes).
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.tipShare.Desc: Largest tip a guest leaves on top of a purchase, as a share of the price, for a perfect tender. The chance and size of a tip grow with the tender's Social skill.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.vendingPrice.Desc: Multiplies the market value of what vending machines sell.
keyed.HH.Setting.venues.waitForStaffTicks.Desc: A guest waits this long for somebody to come to an open but unstaffed venue, then gives up annoyed.
keyed.HH.Setup.BannerAttention: The furniture is complete. Check the open points below so guests are served.
keyed.HH.Setup.BannerMissing: This {0} still misses some of its furniture.
keyed.HH.Setup.BannerNotReady: Not ready: this {0} opens once everything marked Required stands in the room.
keyed.HH.Setup.BannerReady: Everything this business needs is in place.
keyed.HH.Setup.BuildButtonDesc: This {0} still needs {1}. Click to place one in the room.
keyed.HH.Setup.FooterLoose: The rule 'Venues need their furniture' is off: missing items are only hints.
keyed.HH.Setup.FooterStrict: Required furniture keeps the business closed until it stands in the room. You can turn that rule off in the Shops & Food settings.
keyed.HH.Setup.GizmoDesc: Open the setup guide of this business: what its kind needs, what it already has, with build buttons for everything that is missing.
keyed.HH.Setup.HonorNotNeeded: not needed with the honor system
keyed.HH.Setup.LoadNotice: Not ready to open, furniture missing: {0}. The sign's Setup tab has build buttons.
keyed.HH.Setup.NowReady: {0} has everything it needs and is ready to open.
keyed.HH.Setup.OperationalTip: Needed for guests to be served; it does not keep the doors shut.
keyed.HH.Setup.RecommendedTip: Recommended: the business works without it, but guests like it.
keyed.HH.Setup.RestockTip: Let the sign set the room's shelves and stockpiles to take your goods.
keyed.HH.Setup.ShowTip: Point at what the room already has.
keyed.HH.Setup.StaffHint: Switch on the Serving work type for at least one colonist.
keyed.HH.Setup.StockHint: Store what this business sells inside the room.
keyed.HH.Setup.WorkTabTip: Open the work tab and give a sociable colonist the Serving work type.
keyed.HH.Venue.BellNobody: Night bell: ringing, nobody has come yet
keyed.HH.Venue.BellOnTheWay: Night bell: {0} is on the way
keyed.HH.Venue.BellUnanswered: The night bell at {0} is ringing, but nobody is coming. Colonists with the Serving work type need to be awake and within earshot.
keyed.HH.Venue.CheckNoCounter: No counter (optional) → the tender stands next to the sign
keyed.HH.Venue.CheckNoDishes: No plates for sale → cook dishes and store them in the room
keyed.HH.Venue.CheckNoDrinks: No drinks in stock → store beer or other drinks in the room
keyed.HH.Venue.CheckNoStock: No goods for sale → put a shelf or stockpile with goods in the room
keyed.HH.Venue.CheckNoWorker: Nobody has the Serving work type switched on
keyed.HH.Venue.ChooseTypeDesc: Choose what kind of business the room of this sign is: tavern, shop, restaurant, casino, spa or lounge.
keyed.HH.Venue.ColonyMayTakeDesc: Off: goods for sale in this room are forbidden for your colonists, so nobody carries your stock away. On: colonists treat the goods like any other stored item.
keyed.HH.Venue.HoursDesc: Set when the business is open. Presets for day, evening, night and around the clock.
keyed.HH.Venue.HoursHint: A closing hour earlier than the opening hour means the business stays open past midnight.
keyed.HH.Venue.MarketFees: The traders pay {0} silver for their stalls.
keyed.HH.Venue.MarketText: Word has spread: it is market day. {0} trader caravans and {1} groups of visitors from {2} are on their way to your colony. Traders will trade as usual at their camps; visitors will browse your shops and taverns if they are open.\n\nKeep your shelves stocked and your counters staffed.
keyed.HH.Venue.NameAutoHint: A suggested name follows the sign if you change the kind of business; a name you type stays.
keyed.HH.Venue.NameSuggestTip: Roll a name that fits this kind of business. Roll again until you like one.
keyed.HH.Venue.NoRoom: Not a business yet: the sign needs an enclosed, roofed room.
keyed.HH.Venue.PriceDesc: Price factor on everything this business sells. Guests are put off by prices that are too high.
keyed.HH.Venue.PriceEmpty: Nothing for sale in the room yet.
keyed.HH.Venue.PriceHintShort: Guests compare the price with what the item is worth to them; wealthy guests put up with more. Free means free.
keyed.HH.Venue.PriceNoGoods: This kind of business does not sell goods from its room.
keyed.HH.Venue.PriceNow: Guests pay {0} % of the market value right now
keyed.HH.Venue.RestockDesc: Let this sign set the storage places in its room to take your goods with priority Important, so haulers keep the shelves full. Opt-in; old settings come back when you switch it off.
keyed.HH.Venue.RestockFooter: Storage places in this room: {0} · stacks for sale now: {1}
keyed.HH.Venue.RestockHint: When on, every storage place in this room (stockpile zones and shelves, yours or anybody's) takes the goods ticked below with priority Important, so your haulers keep the room stocked. The places' old settings come back when you switch this off.
keyed.HH.Venue.RestockNoShop: This business does not sell anything from its room, so there is nothing to restock.
keyed.HH.Venue.RestockStateOff: Restock is off: the room's storage keeps its own settings
keyed.HH.Venue.RestockStateOn: Restock is on: the room's storage follows this list

defs.ThingDef/HH_VenueSign.label: venue sign
defs.ThingDef/HH_VenueSign.description: A sign that turns the room it stands in into a business: tavern, shop, restaurant, casino, spa or lounge. Choose the kind of business, opening hours and prices in the sign's controls. Without a sign, a room is just a room.
defs.ThingDef/HH_VenueSignWall.label: venue sign (wall)
defs.ThingDef/HH_VenueSignWall.description: The same sign, hung on a wall. The room it faces becomes the business. Choose the kind of business, opening hours and prices in the sign's controls.
defs.ThingDef/HH_ShopCounter.label: shop counter
defs.ThingDef/HH_ShopCounter.description: A counter for a shopkeeper or bartender. Whoever tends the venue stands behind it, and the day's takings are put down as silver here at midnight. A counter is optional: without one, the tender stands next to the sign.
defs.ThingDef/HH_MarketStall.label: market stall
defs.ThingDef/HH_MarketStall.description: A free-standing stall with a striped awning. The big market only takes place once you own enough stalls (see the Venues settings): every trader caravan sets up at one and pays a stall fee into your till. Standing outside, it works in any weather but is not a business of its own.
defs.ThingDef/HH_VendingMachine.label: vending machine
defs.ThingDef/HH_VendingMachine.description: A powered cabinet that holds food, drinks, drugs and medicine. Guests buy from it at any hour without any staff, at market value. Haulers fill it like a shelf. Colonists may help themselves for free; the machine only charges guests. Needs power to sell.
defs.WorkGiverDef/HH_ServeVenue.label: tend venues
defs.ThingDef/HH_Mote_Bell.label: night bell
defs.ThingDef/HH_Mote_RingArc.label: ring
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_WokenByBell.stages.0.label: woken by the night bell
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_WokenByBell.stages.0.descr: Somebody rang the bell in the middle of my sleep. Duty calls. Loudly.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_WokenByBell.stages.1.label: woken by the night bell
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_WokenByBell.stages.1.descr: Somebody rang the bell in the middle of my sleep. Well, that is the job. I will sleep later.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ServedBusy.stages.0.label: a good shift
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ServedBusy.stages.0.descri: Guests kept coming to the counter and I had something to do the whole time. That is how work should feel.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ServedBusy.stages.1.label: a busy shift
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ServedBusy.stages.1.descri: One guest after the other. I knew every order before they finished asking. A good kind of tired.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ServedBusy.stages.2.label: rushed off my feet
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ServedBusy.stages.2.descri: The whole room wanted something at once and I kept up with all of it. I'm proud of that shift.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ServedIdle.stages.0.label: bored at the counter
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ServedIdle.stages.0.descri: I stood behind the counter for ages and nobody came. I polished the same glass three times.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ServedIdle.stages.1.label: stood around all shift
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ServedIdle.stages.1.descri: Hours at the counter with nothing to do. I could have been doing something useful.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ServedIdle.stages.2.label: a pointless shift
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ServedIdle.stages.2.descri: An entire shift of waiting for guests who never came. What am I even standing here for?
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Tavern.desc: A room where guests buy a drink and drink it on the spot. Stock the room with beer or other drinks on a shelf or in a stockpile; a bartender behind the sign or counter keeps it open. Drinks in the room are reserved for customers unless the sign says otherwise.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Shop.label: shop
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Shop.descri: A room where guests buy goods. Everything stored on shelves and in stockpiles inside the room is for sale, at market value times the sign's price factor. Without a shopkeeper the shop runs as self-service at a small discount.
A room where guests sit down and eat. Tables, a kitchen and a waiter make it a restaurant; guests pay for the plates and meals on its shelves and tables. Cooking is done by the kitchen; stale plates are not for sale.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Casino.desc: A room of card tables, slot machines and croupiers. Guests stake their silver on games of chance; the house keeps a small, honest edge.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Spa.label: spa
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Spa.descrip: A quiet room for baths, steam and rest. An attendant keeps the towels warm; guests pay by the visit.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Lounge.desc: A waiting room with seats. Guests who find a business closed or unstaffed wait here instead of in the doorway, and wait more patiently. Always open, no staff needed.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Chapel.desc: A quiet room with a guest altar where visitors of every faith come to pray. Guests pay nothing but leave calmer; a chapel with a handsome altar and a few pews is a good neighbour for an inn. Always open during the day, no staff needed.
